note: Cross-method prevalence transfer on the shared held-out TEST fold of slm_mod_split.parquet -- the L493 basis. Zero-shot LLM arms only (no few-shot); SLM-Mod and the frozen-e5 per-community heads on the same fold. Per sub: TPR/FPR at the arm's native decision, then the PPV identity ppv(tpr, fpr, pi) at pi=0.5 and at the sub's natural removal rate. Differs from prevalence_transfer.json by design (that file is FULL-corpus per family); the encoder arm reproduces fairness_compare.json's precision_at_natural_prevalence.
